# Test data

Examples from the gridyard local API contract, version `api` 1 (planning repository, commit `e638e7a`), unchanged.
Values are synthetic.

| File | Endpoint |
| --- | --- |
| `device-info.json` | `device-info` |
| `state.json` | `state` |
| `state-without-record.json` | `state` of a device without live record (no profile, right after the start): `state.json` with `"record": null`, as the contract describes (`5143772`) |
